Migration safeguard: "Respaldo automático + deshacer" — the one-time migration of an existing board makes a backup copy of the board file BEFORE migrating, logs every change it makes, and can be reverted; it never runs twice (versioned in board settings); the agent never opens, reads or writes the operator's real board (tests and synthetic boards only).
